description: This Java source file contains a test class `NotePadProviderTest` for testing the content provider of a NotePad application. It includes unit tests for URI handling, MIME type responses, data querying, insertion, deletion, update, and stream operations related to the `NotePadProvider` component.

classes.name: NoteInfo
classes.description: Helper class representing a note's data, including title, note content, creation and modification dates, and methods to generate ContentValues for database operations.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the mock content resolver and the database before each test.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Clean-up method called after each test, currently no specific cleanup implemented.

methods.name: insertData
methods.description: Populates the test database with predefined note instances.

methods.name: testUriAndGetType
methods.description: Verifies correct MIME types are returned for different URIs and tests error handling for invalid URIs.

methods.name: testGetStreamTypes
methods.description: Tests the stream MIME types returned for different content URIs.

methods.name: testOpenTypedAssetFile
methods.description: Tests opening typed asset files with correct MIME types and error cases.

methods.name: testWriteDataToPipe
methods.description: Validates the provider's ability to write data into a pipe, reading and verifying the data content.

methods.name: testQueriesOnNotesUri
methods.description: Checks querying the notes table for various scenarios, including no data, all data, projections, and selection criteria.

methods.name: testQueriesOnNoteIdUri
methods.description: Verifies querying a specific note by its ID URI, including empty and populated cases.

methods.name: testInserts
methods.description: Tests inserting new notes into the database and validating inserted data.

methods.name: testDeletes
methods.description: Ensures deletion of notes works correctly, including attempting deletion on empty and populated tables.

methods.name: testUpdates
methods.description: Tests updating note data, both on empty and non-empty tables, verifying the change.
